notes.title: Major changes are under development.
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

It was a long and unexpected year for the development. I am working on the upgrade of the game. The current build has a lot of issues with the gameplay lags, functions, and the gameplay mechanics are not working.

Current development is on changing the gameplay mechanics, updating the languages, graphic updates, etc. The update is planned to publish in the third week of January. Here I will share a small shot of the current progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38187887/e5be8062af42a811c06f84fcad2277489cfbeed0.png[/img]


Merry Christmas to all and happy holidays...:)

notes.title: Major update is now live
notes.content:
Hi all,
    So after a long time finally we were able to work on the majority of functions of the gameplay and have updated it in the latest build.

Our new update includes the following supporting languages.

English, Chinese(Simplified), German, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese(Brazil), French, Korean, and Russian.

We're working on the next update now so, stay tuned.

Happy Gaming.

notes.title: Artha full release from early access.
notes.content:
Hi all, 
    It's been a long time since we've posted or updated any builds. Previously we were busy working on bug fixings and polishing to make gameplay smoother. Besides that, we added Russian, French, Spanish, and German language support as well.

The game's next build will be ready for its full release and the game is shifting to the paid app from free to play.

Thank you for all the support during the development.

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hi all,
      There was a long hold on announcements regarding the upcoming updates. We've been working on the multiplayer setup for better matchmaking and localization in French, German, Russian and Spanish. The localization is almost finished and we are now working on the multiplayer features and in-game store functions.

The next update will come up somewhere around the 3rd week of January 2020.

Happy Holidays to all!!!...

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 and the game is now Free to play.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 
So today we've updated the game to version 1.0.3 with bug fixes and some addons. The game is going free to play starting today. 

Have fun and join the discussions if you're facing any issues with bugs or gameplay please let us know.

Cheers.

notes.title: The game is going free to play.
notes.content:
We were planning to workout with the free to play model for ARTHA and we've decided to make it free for all the public very soon.  

The upcoming update will have the in-game store feature where players will be able to buy decks using in-game currency. We are constantly working on getting those features ready for all the players. 

For those who have purchased the game can either get a refund or they will get the in-game content for the same price.

So stay tuned and we will see you very soon...:)

notes.title: A big update is coming soon.
notes.content:
[b]About Update:[/b]
So, We've been working on some parts for a few weeks and wanted to share it with you guys. Our next major update is coming soon. We have added an in-game store to buy the decks and the coins system. The way you will play the game and win it will award you coins that you can use to buy the decks.

Here are some shots from the update. 
Store features are still in progress. We will add more cards and levels once the store implementation is finished.

[b]Updates:[/b]
-Implementing Store system ( In progress) 
-New cards and decks will be DLC.
-Price change 
-Total of 80 cards and 6 levels inside the base game.
-Price change.

[b]Screenshots[/b]

Below is the image with the coins system on the top right and new shop button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38187887/b136871981a58452bb699921fe745b74b8b8d311.png[/img]

The price of the game will be changed and players will be able to buy future decks and cards from the in-game shops. They will be able to buy coins through the in-game store.


Thank you everyone and Enjoy.

notes.title: Early access update 1.0.3 is under progress and some BIG announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
   So we've been working on the next update v1.0.3 and trying to grow up the player base.
Next features in progress.

-Bug fixing for some cards not using their abilities.
-Bug fixing for winning and losing condition and effects.
-changing the position of names on 3D cards.
-Adding shop functions in-game to buy the new decks.
-added cards and two boards. which counts a total of 80+ cards and 7 boards.


There is something big coming on the way. Stay tuned for the release of v 1.0.3.

notes.title: Early Access update 1.0.2 and The DEMO is Live now.
notes.content:
Update 1.0.2 is live with the following changes.
-The main menu theme changed.
-Added more cards now there are 70 cards and 4 decks.
-Created the learner's deck to play with the players who are using the demo version.
-Demo version of the game with 2 boards and 1 deck including 15 cards.
-Steam player name on the main menu.


Upcoming Updates.
-Point system for the players.
-Players will have a badge with their profiles. They will get 10 winning points. 100 Points will upgrade to the next level badge.
-Losers will lose 10 points from progress.
-More cards and decks.


Grab the demo and start experiencing the gameplay.
Thank you, everyone.

notes.title: Early Access 1.0.2 and DEMO is on the way
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 
   We've been working on the updates since the launch and we are going to publish a DEMO of the game including 15 cards and 2 boards. The early access update 1.0.2 will have improved UI and updated cards with +1 Board.

Stay tuned for more information or ask the questions here.

notes.title: Early Access Next update 1.0.2 in Progress.
notes.content:
Hello, all the gamers. So, We are working on the next update and it is expected to come on [b]8th August.[/b]

[b]What to expect.[/b]

-Updated Main menu
-Additional 20 cards and updated abilities.
-Two levels
-Bug Fixes
-Sound effects and special effects update.

[b]Future Goals[/b]
-We are testing on dedicated servers.
-Adding achievements and badge system.

Thank you for your support. Please let us know if you have any issues or suggestions.

notes.title: The launch is two days away and so the launch discount.

Happy Gaming everyone...:)

notes.title: ARTHA release date extended
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38187887/ef5e4db5952d6fd9d100a1f5617e0f75ea5188cc.png[/img]


We have delayed the release date to 31st July. We are working on few bug fixings and build setup before we post it to the store. As COVID 19 situation is making things slower we will need a few days for the approval of the build. 

Please follow the discussions and social media pages for upcoming updates.
